purpose: Fresh offline coding-navigation labels on frozen OpenRelay and Delta source. Prompts omit answer paths. Required files and implementation symbols are audit labels, not model input.

tasks.prompt: A failing test's expected and actual values disappear from the compact failure card. Repair the parse-to-render path while keeping the full log recoverable.
A compound shell command is classified as a safe test despite an unknown later command, and its output is shortened. Preserve fail-open behavior through command recognition and filtering.
A short failure card points to a raw-output reference that cannot be retrieved later. Trace storage and the exposed lookup tool so the reference remains usable within its lifetime.
An explicit workhorse routing request can end up using the premium model. Follow the user-intent decision through runtime model resolution and repair the mismatch.
A high-risk operation is treated as routine and the controller advances without the intended checkpoint. Make checkpoint classification and escalation policy agree.
A request mentioning a dotted source filename and an error code produces the wrong context candidates. Correct signal extraction and the subsequent source probe.
A prepared source excerpt exceeds the intended context budget and its omission is not clear to the model. Fix evidence selection and packet rendering together.
A continuation omits a relevant source digest even though the handoff named that file. Follow handoff creation and session continuation to keep recovery evidence intact.
A project-memory note still appears after one of its source files changes. Ensure source-state freshness is checked before auxiliary context is assembled.
Two project-memory notes disagree over the same source path but both influence the final auxiliary context. Repair note selection and what the assembler reports as rendered.
The relay status command prints settings that differ from the launcher actually used. Trace the status CLI and resolved runtime configuration.
A finished coding turn is missing its usage record in telemetry. Follow completion tracking through the session tracker and event store.
A generated research report includes a claim whose evidence id was never gathered. Keep the report citation filter aligned with the evidence read model.
A chat answer presents an uncited statement as a verified fact. Repair how the answer checks citations against gathered local evidence.
Unaccepted thesis evidence changes the health state. Follow evidence acceptance and the deterministic health computation so only accepted items count.
A data source scoped to a market still ingests instruments from another market. Follow scope construction and pipeline filtering.
The source setup screen enables a provider even when its required setting is empty. Align the adapter setup contract with service-level configuration.
A repeated identical model request misses its cached result and logs another call. Repair the client-to-cache lookup and storage path.
News items are extracted into duplicate structured events after rerunning the pipeline. Follow event extraction and the service orchestration that invokes it.
The normal data pipeline finishes without classifying article stance. Connect the shared pipeline operation with news classification.
A custom market appears in settings but watch targets cannot resolve it correctly. Trace market configuration into target modelling.
The reports screen shows an outdated report as the newest one. Follow report-history ordering into the user-facing screen.
The instrument brief omits recent evidence shown elsewhere in the app. Follow brief construction and the shared service that serves it.
The review queue repeats the same evidence item and misses its source-quality warning. Repair evidence retrieval and queue deduplication.
